extracted.intended_audience: issuers, servicers, master/special servicers, trustees, and registrants preparing loan-level asset pool disclosure for SEC reporting (Reg S-K / Form SF-?)
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed instructions for the loan-level data fields and codes to be reported for asset pools (residential mortgages, commercial mortgages, automobile loans, REO, loss events, etc.) in SEC disclosure. Each entry lists the data point(s) required and any specific guidance or coding instructions provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to repayment plan
rubrics_metrics.description: If the type of loss mitigation is a repayment plan, provide additional information about the most recent repayment plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points required: (1) Most recent repayment plan start date — date the most recent plan started; (2) Most recent repayment plan scheduled end date — scheduled end date; (3) Most recent repayment plan violated date — date obligor ceased complying with the repayment plan. A repayment plan = period where obligor agreed to make monthly mortgage payments greater than the contractual installment to bring a delinquent loan current.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to short sales
rubrics_metrics.description: If the type of loss mitigation is a short sale, provide information about the short sale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Short sale accepted offer amount — amount accepted for a pending short sale; (2) [Reserved]. Short sale defined as servicer working with a delinquent obligor to sell property prior to foreclosure sale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loss mitigation exit
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan has exited loss mitigation efforts during the reporting period, provide exit information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Most recent loss mitigation exit date — date servicer deemed the most recent loss mitigation ended; (2) Most recent loss mitigation exit code — code describing reason the effort ended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loans in the foreclosure process
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is in foreclosure, provide foreclosure-related data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Attorney referral date — date loan referred to a foreclosure attorney; (2) Foreclosure delay reason — code describing reason for delay in foreclosure process; (3) Foreclosure exit date — date loan exited foreclosure (if applicable); (4) Foreclosure exit reason — code describing reason foreclosure proceeding ended (if applicable); (5) NOI Date — date notice of intent was sent informing obligor of acceleration and pending foreclosure initiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to REO (Real Estate Owned)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is REO, provide REO sale and status information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Most recent accepted REO offer amount — amount accepted if offer accepted; (2) Most recent accepted REO offer date — date accepted; (3) Gross liquidation proceeds — gross amount due to issuing entity as reported on Line 420 of HUD-1 if sale closed; (4) Net sales proceeds — net proceeds from escrow closing before servicer reimbursement if sale closed; (5) Reporting period loss amount passed to issuing entity — cumulative loss amount passed during reporting period including adjustments and forgiven principal due to modifications passed through; (6) Cumulative total loss amount passed to issuing entity — cumulative to date including forgiven principal from modifications passed through; (7) Subsequent recovery amount — amount recovered during reporting period subsequent to initial gain/loss recognized at liquidation; (8) Eviction indicator — whether eviction process has begun; (9) REO exit date — date loan exited REO status (if applicable); (10) REO exit reason — code describing reason loan exited REO status (if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to losses — loss claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide details on loss claims and servicer reimbursements at liquidation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points under loss claims: (i) UPB at liquidation — actual unpaid principal balance at liquidation; (ii) Servicing fees claimed — accrued servicing fees claimed at time of servicer reimbursement after liquidation; (iii) Servicer advanced amounts reimbursed—principal — total unpaid principal advances reimbursed; (iv) Servicer advanced amounts reimbursed—interest — total unpaid interest advances reimbursed; (v) Servicer advanced amount reimbursed—taxes and insurance — total unpaid escrow amounts advanced and reimbursed; (vi) Servicer advanced amount reimbursed—corporate — unpaid advances for property inspection and preservation reimbursed; (vii) REO management fees — total REO management (including auction) fees paid over loan life if REO; (viii) Cash for keys/cash for deed — total paid to obligor/tenants to vacate or accelerate deed-in-lieu or complete redemption; (ix) Performance incentive fees — total paid to servicer in exchange for carrying out deed-in-lieu, short sale, or similar activities. (2) [Reserved]

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to mortgage insurance (MI) claims
rubrics_metrics.description: If an MI claim has been submitted, provide MI claim details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) MI claim filed date — date servicer filed MI claim; (2) MI claim amount — amount of claim filed; (3) MI claim paid date — date MI company paid claim (if paid); (4) MI claim paid amount — amount paid by MI company (if decided); (5) MI claim denied/rescinded date — final MI denial date after all servicer appeals (if denied/rescinded); (6) Marketable title transferred date — date deed conveyed to MI company (if conveyed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to delinquent loans
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide delinquency status codes for loans that are delinquent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Non-pay status — code describing delinquency status of the loan; (2) Reporting action code — code defining the default/delinquent status of the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — asset numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: For commercial mortgages in the asset pool, provide asset-number identification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Asset number type — identify source of asset number used; (2) Asset number — unique ID number of the asset. Instruction: Asset number must reference a single asset and be the same across all SEC reports required of an issuer under Sections 13 or 15(d). If an asset is removed and replaced, the new asset should be assigned a unique asset number. (3) Group ID — alpha-numeric code assigned to each loan group within a securitization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — reporting period
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the reporting period for each commercial mortgage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Reporting period begin date; (2) Reporting period end date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — general information about the commercial mortgage
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide origination, terms, underwriting, lien, payment and other general characteristics of each commercial mortgage as of origination/securitization or reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required data points include: (1) Originator (name or MERS org number); (2) Origination date; (3) Original loan amount; (4) Original loan term (months); (5) Maturity date; (6) Original amortization term (months); (7) Original interest rate; (8) Interest rate at securitization; (9) Interest accrual method (code, 'number of days' convention); (10) Original interest rate type (fixed/adjustable/step/other); (11) Original interest-only term (months); (12) First loan payment due date; (13) Underwriting indicator — whether loan met criteria for first level of solicitation/credit-granting/underwriting used to originate the pool asset; (14) Lien position at securitization (code); (15) Loan structure (code describing loan structure and seniority of participated mortgage loan components); (16) Payment type (code describing type/method of payment); (17) Periodic principal and interest payment at securitization; (18) Scheduled principal balance at securitization; (19) Payment frequency (code); (20) Number of properties at securitization; (21) Number of properties at end of reporting period; (22) Grace days allowed — number of days after payment due without late charge (excludes default interest penalties); (23) Interest only indicator — yes/no whether scheduled interest-only is payable temporarily or until full balance due; (24) Balloon indicator — yes/no whether loan requires lump-sum principal at maturity; (25) Prepayment premium indicator — yes/no whether obligor subject to prepayment penalties; (26) Negative amortization indicator — yes/no whether negative amortization is permitted; (27) Modification indicator — yes/no whether loan has been modified from original terms; (28) Information related to ARMs (see separate rubric); (29) Information related to prepayment penalties (see separate rubric for prepayment penalty dates); (30) Information related to negative amortization (see separate rubric).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — information related to ARMs
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is an adjustable-rate mortgage (ARM), provide ARM-specific parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (i) ARM index — code for index; (ii) First rate adjustment date — date first interest rate adjustment is effective post-securitization; (iii) First payment adjustment date — date first payment adjustment becomes effective post-securitization; (iv) ARM margin — spread added to index at securitization; (v) Lifetime rate cap — max interest rate during loan life; (vi) Lifetime rate floor — min interest rate during loan life; (vii) Periodic rate increase limit — max rate increase from any period to next; (viii) Periodic rate decrease limit — max rate decrease from any period to next; (ix) Periodic pay adjustment maximum amount — max absolute change in principal+interest constant on any adjustment date; (x) Periodic pay adjustment maximum percentage — max percentage payment change on any adjustment; (xi) Rate reset frequency — code describing frequency rate is reset due to index adjustment; (xii) Pay reset frequency — code describing frequency payment is adjusted; (xiii) Index look back in days — number of days prior to adjustment effective date used to determine index rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — information related to prepayment penalties
rubrics_metrics.description: If the obligor is subject to prepayment penalties, provide timing information for penalty expiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (i) Prepayment lock-out end date — date after which lender allows prepayment; (ii) Yield maintenance end date — date when yield maintenance penalties are no longer effective; (iii) Prepayment premium end date — date after which prepayment premiums no longer effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgages — information related to negative amortization
rubrics_metrics.description: If loan allows negative amortization, provide limits and amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (i) Maximum negative amortization allowed (% of original balance); (ii) Maximum negative amortization allowed (absolute amount); (iii) Negative amortization/deferred interest capitalized amount — amount capitalized to principal during reporting period; (iv) Deferred interest—cumulative — cumulative deferred interest for reporting period and prior cycles net of any deferred interest collected; (v) Deferred interest collected — amount of deferred interest collected during reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to the property (commercial mortgage collateral)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide identifying, locational, occupancy, valuation, tenant and financial information for each property that collateralizes a loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Property name — name; if defeased populate 'defeased'; (2) Property address — if multiple properties print 'various'; if defeased leave empty; substituted properties populate new property info; (3) Property city — leave empty if defeased; (4) Property state — two character code; (5) Property zip code; (6) Property county; (7) Property type — code describing use; (8) Net rentable square feet; (9) Net rentable square feet at securitization; (10) Number of units/beds/rooms — for multifamily, self-storage, healthcare, lodging, mobile home park; (11) Number units/beds/rooms at securitization; (12) Year built; (13) Year last renovated; (14) Valuation amount at securitization; (15) Valuation source at securitization (code); (16) Valuation date at securitization; (17) Most recent value (if additional valuation obtained after securitization); (18) Most recent valuation date; (19) Most recent valuation source (code); (20) Physical occupancy at securitization — % rentable space occupied; (21) Most recent physical occupancy — most recent %; (22) Property status (code); (23) Defeasance option start date; (24) Defeasance status (code indicating if loan has/is able to be defeased); (25) Largest tenant — identify tenant leasing largest sq ft (instructions: if not occupying but paying rent print 'Dark'; if sub-leased print 'Sub-leased/name'); (25)(ii) Square feet of largest tenant; (25)(iii) Date of lease expiration of largest tenant; (26) Second largest tenant and similar subfields and instructions; (27) Third largest tenant and subfields; (28) Financial information related to the property as of most recent date — includes (i) date of financials as of securitization; (ii) most recent financial as of start date; (iii) most recent financial as of end date; (iv) revenue at securitization; (v) most recent revenue; (vi) operating expenses at securitization (included/excluded items defined); (vii) operating expenses (most recent) (inclusions/exclusions defined); (viii) net operating income at securitization; (ix) most recent net operating income; (x) net cash flow at securitization; (xi) most recent net cash flow; (xii) NOI/net cash flow indicator at securitization (code describing method used); (xiii) NOI/net cash flow indicator (most recent) (code); (xiv) most recent debt service amount; (xv) debt service coverage ratio (NOI) at securitization; (xvi) most recent debt service coverage ratio (NOI); (xvii) debt service coverage ratio (net cash flow) at securitization; (xviii) most recent debt service coverage ratio (net cash flow); (xix) debt service coverage ratio indicator at securitization (code for multi-property calculation); (xx) most recent debt service coverage ratio indicator; (xxi) date of most recent annual lease rollover review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to activity on the loan (commercial mortgages)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report activity indicators, balances, payments, advances and ARM next-rate/payment details for the reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Asset added indicator — yes/no whether asset added during reporting period (response required only when assets added after final prospectus §230.424 filed); (2) Modification indicator—reporting period — yes/no whether loan modified during reporting period; (3) Reporting period beginning scheduled loan balance; (4) Total scheduled principal and interest due — amount due in month corresponding to current distribution date; (5) Reporting period interest rate — annualized gross interest rate used to calculate scheduled interest; (6) Servicer and trustee fee rate — sum of annual fee rates payable to servicers and trustee; (7) Scheduled interest amount — gross interest scheduled to be collected during reporting period; (8) Other interest adjustment — unscheduled interest adjustments during reporting period; (9) Scheduled principal amount; (10) Unscheduled principal collections — principal prepayments and other unscheduled principal payments during reporting period; (11) Other principal adjustments — amounts causing principal balance decreases/increases not scheduled or unscheduled collections; (12) Reporting period ending actual balance; (13) Reporting period ending scheduled balance — scheduled/stated principal balance per servicing agreement; (14) Paid through date — date loan's scheduled P&I is paid through as of end of reporting period; (15) Hyper-amortizing date — date after which principal & interest may amortize at accelerated rate and/or mortgagor interest increases substantially; (16) Information related to servicer advances — (i) Servicing advance methodology (code describing manner advances are made); (ii) Non-recoverability determined — yes/no whether master/special servicer ceased advancing principal/interest and/or servicing the loan; (iii) Total principal and interest advance outstanding; (iv) Total taxes and insurance advances outstanding; (v) Other expenses advance outstanding; (17) Payment status of loan (code); (18) Information related to activity on ARM loans — (i) ARM index rate for reporting period; (ii) Next interest rate — annualized gross interest rate to be used for next scheduled interest payment; (iii) Next interest rate change adjustment date; (iv) Next payment adjustment date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to servicers (commercial mortgages)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide identities and transfer dates for servicers involved with the loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Primary servicer — name of entity that services or will have right to service the asset; (2) Most recent special servicer transfer date — date transfer letter/email accepted by special servicer; (3) Most recent master servicer return date — date return letter/email accepted by master servicer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset subject to demand (repurchase/replace for reps and warranties)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the loan was subject to repurchase/replace demand during reporting period and provide demand resolution details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/no whether loan was subject to demand for repurchase/replace for breach of reps and warranties, including investor demands upon a trustee. If yes, provide: (1) Status of asset subject to demand — code describing status as of end of reporting period; (2) Repurchase amount — amount paid to repurchase loan from pool; (3) Demand resolution date — date repurchase/replace demand resolved; (4) Repurchaser — name of repurchaser; (5) Repurchase or replacement reason — code describing reason for repurchase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Realized loss to trust
rubrics_metrics.description: Report realized loss experienced by the trust for the loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the difference between net proceeds (after liquidation expenses) and the scheduled or stated principal of the loan as of the beginning of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to prepayments (liquidations/unscheduled principal)
rubrics_metrics.description: If a prepayment or liquidation was received, provide code, date and any premium/yield maintenance amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Liquidation/Prepayment code — code assigned to unscheduled principal payments or liquidation proceeds in reporting period; (2) Liquidation/Prepayment date — effective date of unscheduled principal payment or liquidation proceeds; (3) Prepayment premium/yield maintenance received — amount received from borrower in exchange for payoff prior to maturity or anticipated repayment date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workout strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code describing steps being taken to resolve the loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the code that best describes the workout strategy for the loan (e.g., modification, short sale, foreclosure, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to modifications (most recent modification)
rubrics_metrics.description: If loan has been modified from original terms, provide details about the most recent modification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (1) Date of last modification — date of most recent modification (modification = any material change to loan documents excluding assumptions); (2) Modification code — code describing type of modification; (3) Post-modification interest rate — new initial interest rate after modification; (4) Post-modification payment amount — new initial P&I payment after modification; (5) Post-modification maturity date — new maturity date after modification; (6) Post-modification amortization period — new amortization period in months after modification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — asset numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: For automobile loans in the asset pool, provide asset-number identification similar to other asset types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (a)(1) Asset number type — identify source of asset number; (a)(2) Asset number — unique ID number. Instruction: Asset number must reference a single asset and be the same number used across reports required of an issuer under Sections 13 or 15(d). If asset removed and replaced, assign unique new asset number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — reporting period
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify reporting period begin and end dates for each automobile loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (b)(1) Reporting period begin date; (b)(2) Reporting period end date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — general information about the automobile loan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide origination, terms, underwriting and payment characteristics of each automobile loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points include: (c)(1) Originator — name; (c)(2) Origination date; (c)(3) Original loan amount; (c)(4) Original loan term (months); (c)(5) Loan maturity date (month and year of final scheduled payment); (c)(6) Original interest rate; (c)(7) Interest calculation type — simple or other; (c)(8) Original interest rate type — fixed/adjustable/other; (c)(9) Original interest-only term — months from origination interest-only permitted; (c)(10) Original first payment date; (c)(11) Underwriting indicator — whether loan met first-level underwriting criteria; (c)(12) Grace period — months during which interest accrues but no payments due; (c)(13) Payment type — code for frequency or balloon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — information related to the vehicle
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide vehicle-specific data for each automobile loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (d)(1) Vehicle manufacturer; (d)(2) Vehicle model; (d)(3) New or used indicator at origination; (d)(4) Model year; (d)(5) Vehicle type (code); (d)(6) Vehicle value at origination; (d)(7) Source of vehicle value (code).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — information related to the obligor
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide obligor credit, verification, co-obligor and payment-to-income and location data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (e)(1) Obligor credit score type — type of standardized credit score used at origination; (e)(2) Obligor credit score — standardized credit score; (e)(3) Obligor income verification level — code describing extent of income verification during origination; (e)(4) Obligor employment verification — code describing extent of employment verification; (e)(5) Co-obligor present indicator — yes/no whether co-obligor exists; (e)(6) Payment-to-income ratio — scheduled monthly payment as % of total monthly income of obligor(s) at origination (provide methodology in prospectus); (e)(7) Geographic location of obligor — current U.S. state or territory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automobile loans — information related to activity on the loan
rubrics_metrics.description: Report activity indicators, balances, scheduled/actual amounts, servicer advances and fee information over the reporting period for automobile loans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data points: (f)(1) Asset added indicator — yes/no whether asset was added during reporting period (response required only when added after final prospectus §230.424 filed); (f)(2) Remaining term to maturity — months from end of reporting period to loan maturity; (f)(3) Modification indicator—reporting period — yes/no whether asset modified during reporting period; (f)(4) Servicing advance method — code for servicer's responsibility advancing principal/interest on delinquent loans; (f)(5) Reporting period beginning loan balance; (f)(6) Next reporting period payment amount due; (f)(7) Reporting period interest rate — current interest rate in effect during reporting period; (f)(8) Next interest rate — interest rate in effect for next reporting period (if not paid off); (f)(9) Servicing fee—percentage — percentage used if servicing fee is percentage; (f)(10) Servicing fee—flat-fee — monthly flat fee if applicable; (f)(11) Other loan-level servicing fee(s) retained by servicer — amount of other fees reducing funds remitted to issuing entity (including subservicing, master servicing, trustee fees, etc.); (f)(12) Other assessed but uncollected servicer fees — cumulative late charges and other assessed fees not paid by obligor; (f)(13) Scheduled interest amount — interest scheduled during reporting period; (f)(14) Scheduled principal amount; (f)(15) Other principal adjustments; (f)(16) Reporting period ending actual balance; (f)(17) Reporting period scheduled payment amount — total scheduled payment during reporting period (including fees); (f)(18) Total actual amount paid — total paid to servicer during reporting period; (f)(19) Actual interest collected — gross interest collected during reporting period whether or not from obligor; (f)(20) Actual principal collected — principal collected during reporting period whether or not from obligor; (f)(21) Actual other amounts collected — total of amounts other than principal and interest collected during reporting period whether or not from obligor; (f)(22) Servicer advanced amount — amount advanced by servicer during reporting period if applicable; (f)(23) Interest paid through date.
